method: Direct PDF polyline vertices; piecewise linear calibration between labeled major ticks; linear segment intersection; midpoint for vertical segments. No smoothing or extrapolation except endpoint clamping within 0.01 PDF point.
uncertainty: Conservative +/-0.005 absolute visual reading envelope, not statistical or model uncertainty. Stroke width 0.318975 PDF pt gives about +/-0.00142 fraction; coordinate quantization/stair steps and tick geometry contribute additional uncertainty.
concentration_mapping: Color inherited from main Fig S3b: green=1.5e20, blue=2.0e20, red=2.5e20 cm^-3; inset itself has no separate color legend.

source_prose_comparison_400K.note: Prose is for 2% Na-doped PbTe. Figure density fractions around .81 conflict with implied .23. Do not silently reinterpret or invert the inset labels.
